decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software module that survived the firm's early post-launch pruning and fits its move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management, A likely still has low carrying cost and useful option value, so we would keep it.

F is also closely aligned with the firm's automation and digital infrastructure strategy and can likely be carried as a modular complement to projects at modest cost, although as the newer offer it is slightly less proven, so we would still keep it.
